title: Supplier bank details changed
audience: Payment operations teams holding a payment after a supplier changed its bank details.
rule: A payment to changed bank details stays on hold until the change is independently verified and a Finance Controller records a release decision.
deadline: Hold until verification and the Controller decision are both on record.
preparation: Locate the change request and the channel it arrived through.
Record the independent call-back or verification result.
Route the release decision to the named Finance Controller.

handoff.label: Scope a Snapshot for this workflow

fallback: If verification cannot be completed, keep the hold and escalate to the Controller by phone.

title: Invoice and payment exception
audience: Accounts payable teams reviewing a payment that does not match its invoice or purchase order.
rule: An invoice match does not authorize release. Mismatched amount, payee, or terms requires a documented exception decision by the exception owner.
deadline: Resolve before the scheduled payment run, or hold the item.
preparation: Name the specific mismatch: amount, payee, terms, or reference.
Attach the invoice, purchase order, and receiving record.
Record who decided the exception and under what policy.

handoff.label: Scope a Snapshot for this workflow

fallback: Hold the item and contact the exception owner directly.

title: Agent action outside its delegation
audience: Teams whose AI agent attempted, or was asked to take, an action its delegation does not cover.
rule: A connected tool is not permission. An agent may only act within its recorded delegation; anything outside it requires a human decision.
deadline: Stop the action until a person with authority decides.
preparation: Identify the agent, the requested action, and the tool it would use.
Compare the action with the agent's recorded delegation and limits.
Record the human decision and the authority it rests on.

handoff.label: Scope a Snapshot for this workflow

fallback: Revoke or pause the agent's access and escalate to the authority owner.

title: Above-threshold payment approval
audience: Treasury and finance teams releasing a payment above the configured approval threshold.
rule: Payments above the threshold require two approvers with recorded authority for the amount; the initiator cannot be one of them.
deadline: Release only after both approvals are on record.
preparation: Confirm the amount against the current threshold.
Check that each approver's authority covers this amount and category.
Confirm the initiator is not approving their own request.

handoff.label: Scope a Snapshot for this workflow

fallback: If a second approver is unavailable, keep the payment pending and escalate.

title: Bank, fintech, and provider handoff
audience: Teams explaining a payment outcome that crosses a bank, a fintech, and a service provider.
rule: Each party owns part of the record. A handoff is explained only when the owner and the evidence for each step are identified.
deadline: Agree record ownership before reconstructing the outcome.
preparation: List each party and the step it performed.
Identify which records each party holds.
Mark every step where ownership or evidence is not established.
ownerSystem: Named workflow owner at each party

handoff.label: Scope a Snapshot for this workflow

fallback: Contact the counterpart owner at each party; do not infer missing records.

title: Missing evidence or unexplained outcome
audience: Operational risk teams facing an outcome the available records do not fully explain.
rule: Supported findings and missing evidence are reported separately. A gap is recorded as a gap, never filled with assumption.
deadline: Record the gap before any conclusion is shared.
preparation: State the outcome and the question it raises.
Collect the records that exist and note their sources.
List what is missing and who would hold it.

handoff.label: Scope a Snapshot for this workflow

fallback: Escalate unexplained outcomes to operational risk for review.
